**Scope check**
Does this need Gmail permissions beyond `gmail.readonly`, `gmail.modify` and
`gmail.send`? If so, please read `docs/decisions/0001-trash-not-permanent-delete.md`
first — widening scopes is an ADR-level decision, not a feature.
